resources.string: Disconnects this iPhone’s original Bluetooth hands-free connection while CarPlay is active and restores it on exit. Keeps Bluetooth and music audio enabled. Unavailable with vehicle Bluetooth audio. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.

Disconnects this iPhone’s original Bluetooth music connection while CarPlay is active and restores it on exit. Keeps Bluetooth enabled. Independent of the hands-free switch. Unavailable with vehicle Bluetooth audio. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.
